dct_description_sm: The Polar Data Catalogue (PDC, https://www.polardata.ca), and its parent organization, the Canadian Cryospheric Information Network (CCIN, https://www.ccin.ca), are an online archive and educational outreach portal for Arctic and Antarctic research data and information.  Since its online launch in 2007, the PDC has become Canada's primary on-line source for data on the environment of the north and south polar regions and the people who live in the Arctic.  Headquartered in the Department of Geography and Environmental Management at the University of Waterloo, we partner with a variety of Canadian and international polar research and monitoring organizations to facilitate access to polar data, including the ArcticNet Network of Centres of Excellence; Polar Knowledge Canada (POLAR) and the Canadian High Arctic Research Station (CHARS); the Beaufort Regional Environmental Assessment (BREA), the Northern Contaminants Program (NCP), the Nunavut General Monitoring Plan (NGMP), and the International Polar Year (IPY) programs of Indigenous and Northern Affairs Canada (INAC); the international Circumpolar Biodiversity Monitoring Programme; and others.  The PDC and CCIN portals also have interactive data visualization and social networking tools to more effectively share information about Canada's cold regions.
dct_title_s: The Polar Data Catalogue - A Canadian Repository of Arctic and Antarctic Data and Information
